newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone rises on bid rumours.
newsitem.headline: Danone rises on bid rumours.

text.p: Shares in food group Danone rose on Thursday on the back of a returning rumour the company could be the object of a bid, with dealers naming Anglo-Dutch Unilever as possible suitor.
At 0931 GMT, Danone was up 2.32 percent at 882 francs.
There was no immediate comment at Danone.

The rumour had been in the market late on Wednesday but the commotion around a fall on Wall Street following remarks of Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan had diverted attention from many dealers.
On Thursday morning, however, the La Tribune newspaper mentioned the rumour it its financial section.
Danone has been rising spectacularly from 715 francs at January 2.
It reported an eight percent increase in net income to 3.380 francs on January 29.
